skill.description: Use ZenTao REST API v2.0 to query and update projects, products, bugs, tasks, requirements, tests, releases, users, and related records.

security_audit.summary: The skill is a legitimate ZenTao REST API helper, and many static hits are Markdown code spans or intended API examples. Confirmed issues are the eval-based token helper and plaintext persistent token cache in ~/.zentao-token.json. These can expose long-lived credentials and enable shell execution from malicious token values.

remediation.suggestion: Stop using eval for helper output. Emit JSON or dotenv text and parse it without executing server-controlled values.
Store tokens in an OS credential store, or create the cache with 0600 permissions and clear rotation guidance.

remediation.issue: Password login can target arbitrary URLs
remediation.suggestion: Require HTTPS by default and warn before sending credentials to non-HTTPS or untrusted ZenTao hosts.
Document safer setup steps that export fixed values or call a reviewed wrapper without eval.

semantic_findings.title: Unsafe Eval-Based Credential Export
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells agents to run eval "$(bash scripts/get-token.sh)", while the helper prints ZENTAO_URL, ZENTAO_TOKEN, and ZENTAO_ACCOUNT without shell escaping. A token from cache, environment, or server response can execute shell syntax when evaluated.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented eval command is explicit, and the helper emits raw assignment lines without shell quoting. The token value can originate from a server response or cache file.

semantic_findings.title: Persistent Plaintext ZenTao Token Cache
semantic_findings.description: The helper states ZenTao tokens are permanent and writes token, URL, and account data to ~/.zentao-token.json without setting restrictive permissions. This can expose long-lived API credentials to local users or backups.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cache path and write operations are explicit, and the script comments say ZenTao tokens are permanent. No chmod or credential-store protection is present in the helper.

content.user_title: Manage ZenTao Projects Through the API
content.value_statement: Teams need fast access to ZenTao work items without manually building API requests. This skill maps natural language requests to ZenTao REST API v2.0 calls.
actual_capabilities: Authenticates with a provided token or account credentials.
Maps common ZenTao requests to REST API v2.0 endpoints.
Queries projects, products, executions, bugs, tasks, requirements, and users.
Creates and updates bugs, tasks, stories, test cases, plans, builds, releases, feedback, and tickets.
Uses API reference details for required fields, filters, pagination, and enum values.
Confirms write operations before execution unless the user explicitly skips confirmation.
limitations: Requires a reachable ZenTao server and valid credentials.
Custom ZenTao plugins or changed fields may need manual endpoint checks.
Write actions can change or delete project data, so approvals are important.
The token helper stores credentials locally unless modified.

use_cases.title: Review Delivery Status
use_cases.description: Review active projects, executions, and blocked work without manually composing API URLs.

use_cases.title: Triage Bugs and Test Work
use_cases.description: Create, filter, resolve, or close bugs and test records using consistent ZenTao fields.

use_cases.title: Maintain Sprint Tasks
use_cases.description: Update tasks, requirements, builds, and releases while preserving required workflow fields.

prompt_templates.title: List Active Projects
prompt_templates.prompt: Show active ZenTao projects and list their active executions. Include names, IDs, owners, and current status.

prompt_templates.title: Find Product Bugs
prompt_templates.prompt: Find open bugs for product 12. Sort newest first and summarize severity, assignee, and title.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Confirmed Bug
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a new bug for product 12 with title, severity, build, and assigned owner. Ask me to confirm before creating it.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Release Updates
prompt_templates.prompt: Review project 8 bugs, tasks, and builds. Propose release actions, then confirm each ZenTao write operation before execution.

output_examples.input: Show active projects and their executions.
output_examples.output: A concise project list with IDs, active execution names, status, owners, and next lookup suggestions.

output_examples.input: Create a critical bug for product 12.
output_examples.output: A confirmation summary showing target product, title, severity, build, assignee, and the exact fields that will be submitted.
A status update that confirms the resolved bug, resolution value, server response summary, and any follow-up fields.

best_practices: Set ZENTAO_URL and ZENTAO_TOKEN in environment variables before use.
Confirm all create, update, delete, and status-change operations.
Review required fields in the API reference before sending write requests.
anti_patterns: Do not paste permanent tokens into chat transcripts.
Do not run destructive changes without confirming target IDs.
Do not rely on default grade values when creating Story, Epic, or Requirement records.

faq.question: What does this skill connect to?
faq.answer: It connects to ZenTao REST API v2.0 on a server you provide.

faq.question: Does it need credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. It needs a ZenTao URL and either a token or account credentials.

faq.question: Can it change ZenTao records?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create, update, delete, and transition records when you approve those actions.

faq.question: Which modules are covered?
faq.answer: It covers projects, products, executions, requirements, bugs, tasks, tests, releases, users, files, feedback, and tickets.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: How does authentication work?
faq.answer: It uses environment variables or the helper script to obtain the ZenTao URL, token, and account.
